description.value:
Duration constant

Immunity to stupefied, with a save turned automatic critical success once a day.

You're immune to the stupefied condition. Once per day, when you would fail a saving throw against a mental effect, you may instead treat it as a critical success. Pride, taken far enough, stops being a flaw and starts being armor.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, when you would fail a save against a mental effect, you may instead treat it as a critical success" is P-DEGREE-REACTIVE: AdjustDegreeOfSuccess registers its predicate in beforePrepareData, before the roll resolves (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts), so it has no hook for a player's post-roll voluntary choice made once per day. Every real failure-to-success AdjustDegreeOfSuccess found this pass (sneak-adept.json, forager.json, cooperative-soul.json, icy-apotheosis.json) is an unconditional passive with no frequency cap and no player choice at the moment of the roll.
